segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Settle and choose the breath as one clear frequency. Feel it where the signal is easiest to detect.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Listen with the body to one full inhale... one full exhale.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Thoughts may produce static, music, headlines, and weather reports. Notice the broadcast.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Turn the dial gently back to breathing. No need to smash the radio.
[soft, slow, warm voice] When sound distracts you, name hearing. When thought distracts you, name thinking. Then tune back.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [reassuringly] Every noticed distraction proves awareness is working.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Count five breaths if useful. One... two... three... four... five... then release the numbers.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Stay near the smallest breath detail you can feel without straining.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Let static rise and fall around the signal. You do not need perfect reception.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Rest in the repeated movement of losing and finding the frequency.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Expand hearing to every channel in the room while keeping a faint sense of breath.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Open your eyes and carry one clear frequency into the next task.
